limits: Baseline-only diagnostic. No candidate run or reversal of 0715 rejection.
No sample or child exclusions, replacement runs, or stop-on-good-result rule.
One newly built binary; no claim of bit-identical historical executable.
Context snapshots and wait4 cover setup, warmups, untimed work and report writing, not the measured serialization interval.
No hardware, scheduler, allocator, hash-seed or frequency causal attribution.
Warmup comparison varies prior work and process duration; not an isolated cache intervention.
No lifecycle, atomic durability, scaling, throughput, allocation reduction or cold-cache claim.

One fresh process per job with 200 in-process measured iterations. Generic filesystem_fresh_child_per_sample and filesystem_process_isolated report fields are not applicable evidence for this ordinary-save route.
Rust RandomState, ASLR and allocator layout are uncontrolled. PERL_HASH_SEED does not fix Rust hashing. Only listed environment variables are constrained or recorded.
